judge.rationale: The candidate implements the basic schema compilation and `execute` validation logic, but appears to have stopped mid-implementation with an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file and an extra `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file left in the diff. It fails to cache dynamic tool definitions by schema object reference (`WeakMap`), does not log validation failures, and logs `executing` even when validation fails. Several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing (extra properties passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw, static compile count). Furthermore, all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`), the JSDoc comment on `execute`, and the full `CHANGELOG.md` entry are completely omitted.
